post.title: Nearly 2 in 3 dollars saved in Vanguard plans ride autopilot
post.ig:
Nearly 2 in 3 dollars saved in Vanguard plans ride on autopilot.
That autopilot is a target-date fund: nearly 2 of every 3 contributed dollars went into one in 2025, and 98% of default funds (QDIAs) were target-date funds.
The glide path shifts stocks to bonds. Vanguard's goes from about 90% stocks at 25 to 50% at 65 and 30% by 72.
The average target-date mutual fund fee was 0.27% in 2025 (Morningstar), or $27 a year on a $10,000 example balance.
Sources: Vanguard How America Saves 2026, Morningstar 2026 Target-Date Landscape, FINRA.
